business.description: Elango Industries Limited is evaluating and pursuing opportunities in the renewable energy sector, including development of a 20 MW solar power generation project at Mayiladuthurai, Tamil Nadu, proposed to be implemented in phases starting with approximately 3 MW of solar power generation capacity along with battery energy storage systems. The company is also exploring opportunities in energy storage solutions, power trading and other value-added services.

outlook.statement: The Company continues to evaluate and pursue opportunities in the renewable energy sector, which is witnessing significant growth driven by increasing energy demand, favourable Government policies and the growing emphasis on clean and sustainable sources of energy. The Company views the renewable energy sector as an important avenue for diversification and long-term growth.

The Board is of the view that the Company's continued focus on renewable energy, supported by its experience in the power sector and O&M services, will provide opportunities for long-term sustainable growth and contribute towards enhancing value for the Company's stakeholders.

The Company is actively pursuing the development of a solar power generation project with a proposed capacity of 20 MW in Mayiladuthurai, Tamil Nadu, to be implemented in phases starting with approximately 3 MW capacity coupled with battery energy storage systems.
The Company is exploring opportunities in energy storage solutions, power trading, and value-added services within the renewable energy ecosystem.

The Board believes that the Company's strategic emphasis on renewable energy, coupled with its experience in power generation and O&M services, will support sustainable growth, enhance shareholder value, and contribute positively towards environmental sustainability.
